events.description: Called by the error state's retry button; left out, the error state has no button.
events.name: onRetry

events.description: Called by a column menu's "Filter by this column"; left out, the menu has no such item.
events.name: onFilterColumn

events.description: Called with the ids now selected each time the selection changes, in the order the items are in.
events.name: onSelectionChange

events.description: Web: called with a column's new width, in CSS pixels, when a resize ends.
events.name: onColumnResize

events.description: Web: given, headers can be dragged to reorder the columns; called with the column and its new index.
events.name: onColumnMove

events.description: Called with the whole next query each time the user changes any part of it.
events.name: onQueryChange

events.description: Called with true when the user chooses all matching records and with false when they go back to the rows shown.
events.name: onAllMatchingSelectedChange

events.description: Called when the user asks for the next page (the `pager` form) or for more items (the `load-more` form).
events.name: onNext

events.description: Called when the user asks for the previous page; the `load-more` form has no previous button.
events.name: onPrevious

events.description:
Given, each row gets a drag handle (pointer, keyboard and screen reader, through React Aria's drag and drop) and a
drop calls this with the rows shown in their new order (group and total rows left out). Nothing moves until the
app passes the rows back; reordering a sorted view is the app's call.
events.name: onReorder

events.description: Called with the ids of the expanded rows after a row or "expand all" is pressed.
events.name: onExpandedChange

events.description: Called when a row is opened: a press on the row (Enter from the keyboard).
events.name: onRowOpen

events.description: Called with a valid edited value; the app writes the row (a promise is awaited by nobody: report failures yourself).
events.name: onCellEdit
events.type: (item: TItem, columnId: string, value: DataGridValue) => void | Promise<void>

props.description:
The actions of one row, listed in the row's menu in a last column. The handler of each closes over the row.
Left out, there is no actions column.
props.name: rowActions

props.description: The actions on the selection, drawn by the bulk bar while rows are selected (`selectionMode` `multiple`).
props.name: bulkActions

props.description: What is drawn above the rows, usually a `FilterBar` given the same `query`; the table does not import it.
props.name: filterBar

props.description:
What the table shows in place of its own "no results" state when the query narrows the records and none match.
Left out, an `EmptyState` with the `no-results` reason and a button that clears the filters.
props.name: filteredEmptyState

props.description: The thrown value of a failed fetch. Given, the table shows an `ErrorState` in place of the rows.
props.name: error

props.description: What kind of failure `error` is, so the state's wording and icon fit. Defaults to `unexpected`.
props.name: errorKind

props.description:
Whether the error's message is shown, as for `ErrorState`: by default outside production only, because a server
message is an internal. An app whose error carries text written for the user sets it to true.
props.name: isMessageShown

props.description: The text of the retry button. Defaults to the `ui` catalogue's word in the active locale.
props.name: retryLabel

props.description: The level of the empty and error states' titles, so the page keeps one outline. Defaults to 3.
props.name: headingLevel

props.description: The spoken name of the pagination landmark. Defaults to the table's `label` and the word "pagination".
props.name: paginationLabel

props.description: The spoken name of the bulk bar. Defaults to the table's `label` and the word "actions".
props.name: bulkActionsLabel

props.description:
The id of a column to group the rows by: the rows on screen are gathered under a heading row per value of that
column (in the order the values first appear), which carries the group's count and aggregates.
props.name: groupBy

props.description: The aggregate of each numeric column, by column id: a heading row per group and a total row at the end show it.
props.name: aggregates

props.description: The ids of the columns not drawn, usually from a `ColumnChooser`; the row-header column is always drawn.
props.name: hiddenColumns

props.description:
The collection engine to draw from (`useCollection`), as DataView passes it: the columns as arranged, the sort
keys, the selection, the density, the group and the totals are its, and every change goes back to it. Left out,
the table runs its own engine over `columns`, controlled by `query`, `selectedKeys`, `groupBy`, `aggregates` and
`hiddenColumns` as before.
props.name: collection

props.description: The key the table's own engine keeps the user's column layout under (left out, nothing persists).
props.name: collectionKey

props.description:
True to give each header the column tools: a menu (sort, add to sort, filter, pin, hide, group, summary, resize,
move), a resize handle and drag to reorder.
props.name: hasColumnTools

props.description: The items, in order. The collection never sorts or filters them: the query that fetched them did.
props.name: items

props.description: The look of the table. Defaults to `primary`.
props.name: variant

props.description: The spoken name of the table, for example "Orders"; a table without one is anonymous to assistive technology.
props.name: label

props.description: True while items load: the collection is busy, and shows its loading state in place of the empty one.
props.name: isLoading

props.description: What a press or Space does: nothing, select one item, or toggle several. Defaults to `none`.
props.name: selectionMode

props.description: The columns, in reading order.
props.name: columns

props.description: The spoken name of what loads, for example "Loading orders"; it is read only while `isLoading` is true.
props.name: loadingLabel

props.description: The height the rows scroll inside when the header is sticky, as a CSS length. Defaults to `24rem`.
props.name: maxHeight

props.description: True while a cursor page after the last row exists; with `onLoadMore` it loads it when the end comes into view.
props.name: hasMore

props.description: How tightly the rows are drawn: `compact`, `normal` (the default) or `roomy`. Native reads it as nothing.
props.name: density

props.description:
The content of one cell. Left out, a cell shows the text of the row's property named by the column's `id`; give it
to draw a badge, a date or a link, and give the app's own text for each value, as the table adds none.
props.name: renderCell

props.description: True to keep the header in view while the rows scroll; the table then scrolls inside `maxHeight`.
props.name: isStickyHeader

props.description:
Web: true to give each header a resize handle (pointer, and the keyboard through the column menu's "Resize"); the
columns then take their `width`, `minWidth` and `maxWidth`, and the table scrolls sideways past its width.
props.name: isColumnResizable

props.description: What the collection shows when `items` is empty and nothing is loading, usually an `EmptyState`.
props.name: emptyState

props.description: The ids of the selected items, for a controlled collection; pair it with `onSelectionChange`.
props.name: selectedKeys

props.description: The ids selected at the start, for an uncontrolled collection.
props.name: defaultSelectedKeys

props.description: The query in force: the search text, the applied filters and the sort.
props.name: query

props.description: How many records match the query across all pages, when the server says. Left out, "select all" is not offered.
props.name: totalCount

props.description: True when the user chose every matching record; the bar then reads `totalCount` as the selected count.
props.name: isAllMatchingSelected

props.description: `pager` shows previous and next; `load-more` shows one button that adds the next page. Defaults to `pager`.
props.name: mode

props.description: Whether an earlier page exists, which the app knows from its cursor history. Defaults to false.
props.name: hasPrevious

props.description:
True to draw the row actions that have an icon as buttons revealed on hover or keyboard focus, beside the row
menu, which still lists them all.
props.name: hasHoverActions

props.description: False to leave the browser's own menu on a right-click; by default a row's right-click (or Shift+F10) opens its actions.
props.name: hasContextMenu

props.description: Given, each row gets a disclosure button and an expanded row shows this under it across every column.
props.name: renderRowDetail

props.description: The ids of the expanded rows, for a controlled expansion.
props.name: expandedKeys

props.description: The ids of the rows expanded at first.
props.name: defaultExpandedKeys

props.description: Given, an opened row shows this in a resizable side panel beside the table (a drawer on a small screen).
props.name: renderRowPanel

props.description:
The typed columns edited in place, matched to the table's columns by id: their kind picks the DataGrid editor and
their rules (required, range, the app's own) validate the value. A read-only one is not edited.
props.name: editableColumns

props.description:
Web: true to draw only the rows in view (the Table's virtual scrolling), for thousands of rows: the header and
the start pins stay stuck, group and detail rows scroll with the rest, and the rows scroll inside `maxHeight`.
props.name: isVirtualized

events.description: Starts a keyboard resize of the column; left out, there is no "Resize column".
events.name: onStartResize

events.description: Called by "Filter by this column"; left out, there is no such item.
events.name: onFilterColumn

props.description: The column, as drawn.
props.name: column

props.description: The engine the menu changes.
props.name: collection

events.description: Called when the panel is closed (its close button, Escape in the drawer).
events.name: onClose

props.description: The records' name ("Orders"); the panel is named "<label> details".
props.name: label

props.description: The row open in the panel, or `null` when it is shut.
props.name: item

props.description: The panel's heading for the open row, usually its row header text.
props.name: title

props.description: What the panel shows for the open row.
props.name: renderPanel

props.description: The page beside the panel: the table or the view.
props.name: children

events.description: Called with a valid value; the editor closes.
events.name: onCommit

events.description: Called when the edit is dropped (Escape).
events.name: onCancel

props.description: The cell's typed column: its kind picks the DataGrid editor, its rules validate the value.
props.name: column

props.description: The row, read by the column's own rule.
props.name: row

props.description: The cell drawn under the editor; the editor covers its box.
props.name: anchor

props.description: The input's accessible name: the column and the row.
props.name: label

props.description: The locale the limits of an error are written in.
props.name: locale
